name: Teal glass
description: Dark frosted glass with a teal tint and an accent border.
author: AllBlack11
notes: Tinted acrylic is experimental: it uses an undocumented call and falls back to plain Acrylic if Windows refuses it.
Glass is translucent, so it is not true black. Tint opacity is how strongly the tint covers the blur, not how see-through the whole window is.
